anns.ann: Patients with the CYP2D6*48 allele may have similar enzyme activity of CYP2D6 as compared to patients with the CYP2D6*1 allele. The CYP2D6*48 allele was found to have similar enzyme activity compared to CYP2D6*1 during in-vitro characterization with bufuralol. Other genetic and clinical factors may also influence the metabolism of bufuralol.
